content: Amaṣya, ajeǧid n Yahuda
Deg useggʷas wiss tnayen n Yuwac, mmis n Yahuyaḥaz, ajeǧid n Israil, idweř Amaṣya, mmis n Yuwac, d ajeǧid n Yahuda.
Netta tuɣa ɣares xemsa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa, umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Yahuɛadan, zi Urcalim.
Netta igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, maca war iǧi am babas Dawud. Igga nican am mammec igga babas Yuwac.
Mɣir war ttwakksent řegɛudi. Řgens yiwi ɛad tiɣarṣa d tewhibin n řebxur x řegɛudi.
Umi tuɣa tagelda temten deg ifassen nnes, imsar belli netta inɣa imsexxaren nni inɣin ajeǧid, babas.

Maca iḥenjiren n iqettařen war ten inɣi ca, am mammec t yura deg wedlis ittwannḍen n Ccariɛa n Musa, i di iweṣṣa SIDI, inna: “Ibabaten war ttwaneqqen di ssibbet n iḥenjiren nsen uřa iḥenjiren war ttwaneqqen di ssibbet n ibabaten nsen, maɣar kuř ijj ad ittwaneɣ x ddnub n yixef nnes.”
Netta iɣřeb x ayt n Idum di Teɣzurt n Tmeǧaḥt, ɛecra ařef n yeryazen, u iṭṭef Salaɛ deg umenɣi u igga as Yaqtayil, ař ass-a.
Xenni issekk Amaṣya ireqqasen ɣar Yuwas, mmis n Yahuyaḥaz, mmis n Yahu, ajeǧid n Israil, inna: “As-dd, ejj aneɣ ad nemmeřqa i umenɣi.”

Maca Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil, issekk ijj n ureqqas ɣar Amaṣya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, inna: “Cbarq ak-d isennanen i iɣemmyen x idurar n Lubnan, issekk ict n tebrat ɣar tcejjart n tengelt x idurar n Lubnan, inna: ‘Ewc yeǧis d tamɣart i mmi!’ Maca ijj n řweḥc n řexřa i din yuyuren x idurar n Lubnan, ikka u iɛfes x cbarq ak-d isennanen.
Iwa cek tɣeřbed x Idum u řexxu tdewřed dayek nnfaxet deg wuř nnec. Ṭṭef deg uweqqar i ɣarek u qqim di taddart nnec, minzi mayemmi ɣa temmenḍared ixef nnec di řɣar u ad tewḍid, cek d Yahuda akidek?”
Maca Amaṣya war ixs ad iseř, uca Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil, igeɛɛed ařami netta d Amaṣya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, mmqabařen ɣar Bayt-Cams i iǧan di Yahuda.
Yahuda ittwaɣřeb s ufus n Israil, uca nitni arewřen, kuř ijj ɣar uqiḍun nnes.

Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil, iṭṭef Amaṣya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, mmis n Yuwac, mmis n Axazya, di Bayt-Cams uca yiweḍ t-i-dd ɣar Urcalim. Dinni igga ict n tazzit di řḥiḍ n Urcalim, zi Tewwart n Ifrayim ař Tewwart n Teɣmart, x ijj n webrid n arebɛa-mya n iɣaǧen.
Yiwi marra ureɣ d nnuqart d marra řeqcuɛ i ittwafen di Taddart n SIDI u deg ixxamen n txubay n taddart n ujeǧid, uřa d irehhanen, uca iɛqeb ɣar Samarya.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Yuwac d min igga d tmegga nnes imeḥḍen d mammec immneɣ ak-d Amaṣya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?
Yuwac igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Netta ittwanḍeř di Samarya jar ijeǧiden n Israil. Mmis Yarubɛam idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Amaṣya, mmis n Yuwac, ajeǧid n Yahuda, iddar ɛad xemmesṭac n iseggʷusa awarni i řmewt n Yuwac, mmis n Yahuyaḥaz, ajeǧid n Israil.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Amaṣya, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda?
Nitni ggin ict n tmeɛmuč xas di Urcalim, ařami netta yarweř ɣar Laxic, maca nitni ssekken awarni as inni t iḍfaren ɣar Laxic uca nɣin t dinni.
Nitni iwyen t-i-dd x yeysan u netta ittwanḍeř di Urcalim jar řejdud nnes di tendint n Dawud.
Marra řgens n Yahuda yiwi Ɛazarya, wenni umi ɣar iǧa seṭṭac n iseggʷusa, u ggin t d ajeǧid deg wemcan n babas Amaṣya.
Netta ibna Ilat u yarra i-t deg ufus n Yahuda, awarni řami igga ad yareyyeḥ ujeǧid jar řejdud nnes.
Yarubɛam, ajeǧid n Israil
Deg useggʷas wiss xemmesṭac n Amaṣya, mmis n Yuwac, ajeǧid n Yahuda, idweř Yarubɛam, mmis n Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil di Samarya. Netta iḥkem waḥit u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa di Samarya.
Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI. Netta war iḥeyyed x marra ddnub n Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, wenni yarrin Israil ad ixḍa.

Netta yarra-dd marra tammurt n Israil sadu ufus nnes zi mani ɣa tiwḍed ɣar Ḥamat ař Řebḥar n Řewḍa ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, i tuɣa issiweř s uqemmum n umsexxar nnes Yunus, mmis n Amittay zi Jat-Ḥafir.
Maɣar SIDI iẓra aqa řeɣben n Israil d amerzag aṭṭas u war din iqqim ɛad wenni ittwaṭṭfen d wenni umi jjin u war tuɣi wenni iɛawnen i Israil.
SIDI tuɣa war yenni ad imḥa isem n Israil zi sadu ijenwan, uca issenjem i-ten s ufus n Yarubɛam, mmis n Yuwac.

Imezruyen iqqimen n Yarubɛam d marra min igga d marra timegga nnes imeḥḍen d mammec immneɣ u mammec ikesseb twařa nneɣnit Dimacq d Ḥamat inni tuɣa iǧan ɣar Yahuda, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?
Yarubɛam igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes, jar ijeǧiden n Israil. Mmis Zakariyya idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.

footnotes.text: Salaḥ- isem n yijj n wemcan niɣ n ict n tendint.
